name: king-of-barbecue-platform
description: Enterprise-ready restaurant ordering and operations platform for King of Barbecue.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @kob/shared-types && npm run build -w @kob/config
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kob/api && npm run build -w @kob/worker && npm run build -w @kob/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @kob/api && npm run typecheck -w @kob/worker && npm run typecheck -w @kob/web
scripts.dev: npm run check:services && npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @kob/api" "npm run dev -w @kob/worker" "npm run dev -w @kob/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run check:services && npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kob/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run check:services && npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kob/worker
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kob/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate -w @kob/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && npm run db:seed -w @kob/api
